s: Where did historians find the word 'Andhra', and where did they find the first reference to the Andhras?
Whose side did the Andhras fight in the Mahabharata war?
Which of the following ancient texts does not mention the Telugu people?
x:
The Rigveda does not contain any reference to the Telugu (Andhra) people. Ancient references to the Andhras are found in:
• Aitareya Brahmana – Earliest Vedic reference to the Andhras.
• Arthasastra of Kautilya – Mentions the Andhras as an important political entity.
• Rajatarangini – Contains references to the Andhra region in later historical contexts. Therefore, among the given options, Rigveda is the only text that does not mention the Telugu people. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).
Exam Note:
• Earliest mention of Andhras → Aitareya Brahmana
• Rigveda → No reference to Andhras.
